svg.title: CLA · T3 — Power topology

text.tspan: Three independent supply trees: 230 V from the cabinet, the assured 24 V bus from the pack in R05, PoE backup from NET. Read each row left to right. CLA-BUILD-001 r1 · 2026-10-06
PANEL LINK meters every way below — galvanically isolated, data only
BASE runs on the other one;
bus B floats on its battery;
one socket way trips, one group
goes; egress + NTL-TR on bus B
R06 and R07 sockets kept apart
feed in the floor before screed
5 system + 12 RoomBox + 7 big-load = 24 ways, each a 1-module RCBO (K31) → 29 of 36 M single-phase · 34 of 36 M three-phase
Row 4 (12 M) is free in the distributed variant and becomes the PANEL LINK row. Feed, SPD and phase plan: BUILD-001 §14.
bus B — assured 24 V, survives mains loss
PoE backup path to each sub-controller
